gripOrHq.title: Vintage Camaro
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1], Forgo your next action: Avoid receiving a tag.

gripOrHq.title: Finders Keepers
gripOrHq.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

gripOrHq.title: MS-todon
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. The first time during each run that you break a sentry subroutine with MS-todon, lose all bits from all stealth cards, if you can, and the Corp gives you a tag.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Executive File Clerk
rig.rulesText: [2],[T]: Look at all cards stored in HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

ice.title: Misleading Access Menus
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

encounteredIce.title: Misleading Access Menus
encounteredIce.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.
